```python
import polars as pl

# Create a sample in-memory DataFrame with transactions
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "user": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana", "Eve"],
    "amount": [150, 75, 200, 100, 125]
})

# Build a deferred query using lazy evaluation
query = df.lazy() \
    .filter(pl.col("amount") > 100) \
    .select("user")

# Materialize the result eagerly
result = query.collect()

print(result)
```
